description: Beyond the campaign trail is a husband, a father, a neighbor, and a man whobelieves public service should be about something bigger than politics. You've seen his face on television. You've passed his signs along the road. You've probably received acampaign mailer or seen his name on social media. But who is Jon Maples, really?
title: Who Is Jon Maples?The Man Behind the Signs, theAds, and the Campaign - votemaples.com
